tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The warm gray ground every app sits on — never pure white or cream.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and popovers that sit above the page. Separate with border, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks and wells set into the page.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline between areas, around cards and list rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders, dividers that need to read, outline buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text: descriptions, metadata, secondary labels.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and placeholders. Still passes 4.5:1 on surface and raised.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The brand's own color: the brand logo and the brand's own pages. Apps use accent, which is moss unless the app brings its own color.

tokens.name: moss-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of moss fills.

tokens.name: moss-deep
tokens.usage: Moss as text on moss-tint (chips, selected rows) and for small brand text that needs extra contrast.

tokens.name: moss-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand backgrounds: selected rows, tags, the active nav item.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current app's color. Primary buttons, links, focus, selected states. One accent-filled control per view. Moss by default; each app sets its own (see apps).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Accent as text on accent-tint, and small accent text that needs extra contrast.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, tags, the active nav item.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: shu
tokens.usage: 朱 Shu, a muted vermilion. Chidori's color. Use it through accent, never alongside another app color.

tokens.name: shu-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of shu fills.

tokens.name: shu-deep
tokens.usage: Shu as text on shu-tint.

tokens.name: shu-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet shu backgrounds: selected rows, tags, active nav.

tokens.name: on-shu
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a shu fill.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: 藍 Ai, indigo. The file manager's color. Use it through accent, never alongside another app color.

tokens.name: ai-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of ai fills.

tokens.name: ai-deep
tokens.usage: Ai as text on ai-tint.

tokens.name: ai-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet ai backgrounds: selected rows, tags, active nav.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a ai fill.

tokens.name: budo
tokens.usage: 葡萄 Budō, grape. Free for the next app. Use it through accent, never alongside another app color.

tokens.name: budo-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of budo fills.

tokens.name: budo-deep
tokens.usage: Budo as text on budo-tint.

tokens.name: budo-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet budo backgrounds: selected rows, tags, active nav.

tokens.name: on-budo
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a budo fill.

tokens.name: tetsu
tokens.usage: 鉄 Tetsu, iron teal. Free for the next app. Use it through accent, never alongside another app color.

tokens.name: tetsu-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of tetsu fills.

tokens.name: tetsu-deep
tokens.usage: Tetsu as text on tetsu-tint.

tokens.name: tetsu-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet tetsu backgrounds: selected rows, tags, active nav.

tokens.name: on-tetsu
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tetsu fill.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Decorative only: illustration fills. Never text or status.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Decorative only: rare warm accents in illustrations. Never text or status.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. A muted brick, not alarm red.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error messages; pair with danger text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success uses the brand moss — there is no separate green.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings. A dry ochre, never yellow-on-white.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warnings; pair with warning text.

apps.note: Each app brings one color from the palette and its own motif inside the shared 木瓜 frame. Set accent to the app's color; everything else is shared.

list.name: Brand
list.motif: 狐: a fox's head. The brand's own logo, for its pages and anything without an app of its own.

list.name: Chidori
list.motif: 千鳥: the plover of 波に千鳥.

list.name: Explorer (working name)
list.motif: 入れ子枡: boxes inside boxes, as folders inside folders.

families.sans: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, empty-state headlines, about pages.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text. Generous line height is part of the calm.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Dense UI, list secondary lines, helper text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Numbers that line up, versions, code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; gap in button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; card padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around empty states and major page breaks. When unsure, use more space, not less.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of pages and hero areas on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list highlights. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars only.

shadow.note: Depth comes from borders and surfaces, not shadows. One flat shadow exists for floating menus only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers that float over content. Nothing else.
